common.fixtureBanner: This screen is built from example data, not collected data. Do not rely on it.

home.title: Who are you travelling with?
home.intro: What you choose here changes the verdict on every other screen. Choosing nothing is fine.
howTo: Pick the conditions of the people travelling with you. Several at once is fine.
In the place list, read the verdict and what you would need to check.
On a detail page, expand “How this score was calculated” to see the whole basis of the verdict.
home.cognitiveOption: Travelling with a child who finds new places hard
home.cognitiveHint: Available when you are travelling with a stroller.
home.minRuleTitle: The verdict follows the least-served companion
home.minRule: Calculated for {persona}. The rule keeps an item that is decisive for one person from being averaged away by another person's score.
home.saved: Saved. Your choice survives a refresh.

places.title: Baekje Historic Areas in Gongju and Buyeo
places.sortNote: Ordered: you can visit, check first, not enough information, try elsewhere. “Not enough information” sits above “try elsewhere” because a place we do not know about ranks above one we know you cannot enter.
places.noVerdict: {unknown} of the {total} items that matter for {persona} are unknown
places.mapUnavailable: A map is not part of this release. Everything works from the list above.

place.scoreHiddenReason: Not enough information to judge — check on site
place.confidenceHint: A different number from the score. It says how much there is to judge on.
place.openCalc: See how this score was calculated
place.roundingNote: Displayed values are rounded to three decimals. The score is computed before rounding, so the sum of the rows and the A total can differ in the last digit.
place.freshnessNote: An old check date means uncertainty, not unsuitability, so it does not reduce the score.
place.whyCautionCoverage: Only {known} of the {total} items that matter to you are known
place.axisAllUnknown: All {count} items on the {axis} axis are unknown
place.etcNotesHint: Prose that was never split into individual items. It does not enter the score.
place.goGapReport: See this in the gap report
place.reportsDisclaimer: Written by visitors and not checked by the operator. Separate from the items above, and it does not affect the suitability score.
place.alternativesHint: Places with a better verdict under the same conditions.
place.safetyNote: The distances on the conditions axis are calculated from this list.
place.noPhotos: No photographs have been collected for this place yet.

report.title: Report a condition
report.publicNotice: What you write is published immediately for other visitors. It is shown separately from operator-checked information and does not affect the suitability score.
report.noLocationNotice: This screen does not collect location data.
report.detailHint: Do not write anything that identifies another person by name, contact detail or face.
report.consent: I agree that this is published immediately.

error.place: Choose which place this is about.

diary.storedLocally: This record is stored only in this browser on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
diary.printHint: Use your browser's Print, then Save as PDF, to keep a file.
diary.exportTextHint: Text (.txt, about {size} KB) — for a notes app, an email, or another device
diary.empty: No places added yet. You can add them from the place list or a course.
diary.dateRequired: Choose a date. It goes into the exported files and the printed record.
diary.allAdded: There are no more places to add.

gapReport.title: Barrier-free information gap report, Gongju and Buyeo
gapReport.asOf: As of {date} · {places} places · KTO barrier-free travel items
gapReport.fillCaption: Filled items per place. The three columns add up to that place's item count.
gapReport.fillNote: The first two columns are separate because merging them would raise the “municipal improvement” figure every time we fill a cell ourselves. Only the change in “Filled by KTO” can be read as handover progress.
gapReport.notRegistered: {place} — the place itself is not registered. Registration has to come before item entry.
gapReport.priorityCaption: Improvement priority. Only unknown and unavailable items appear.

causeLegend.unknown: Cause not established — the cell is blank. Checking it is the first task.
causeLegend.operator: Not entered (established) — confirmed with the responsible office.
causeLegend.intrinsic: Structural constraint (established) — hard to install without altering the protected site.

gapReport.causeNote: The cause column states only what we know. An empty response is never read as “the operator did not fill it in”. The column exists so that the officer receiving this report cannot refute its first line.
gapReport.visitorsUnavailable: The visitor trend has not been collected yet.
gapReport.empty: Nothing to list as an improvement priority.
